result.keyword: How to file a UK company confirmation statement and dormant accounts DIY to save agency fees?
result.markdown:
You can file both a **confirmation statement** and **dormant accounts** yourself through official GOV.UK services, paying only the statutory Companies House fee rather than an agency markup. 

### Before You Start: Gather Your Essentials
* **Company Number** (8 characters) and **6-character Companies House Authentication Code** (posted to your registered office if you haven't set one up or need a reminder).[find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/accounts/chooser/dormant#:~:text=You'll%20need%20your%20email%20address%20and%20create,accounts%20on%20the%20Companies%20House%20WebFiling%20service.)
* **Companies House Account** (via GOV.UK One Login) for filing a confirmation statement, plus **identity verification personal codes** for directors where required.[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/file-your-confirmation-statement-with-companies-house#:~:text=Before%20filing%20your%20confirmation%20statement%2C%20you%20may,If%20you%20already%20have%20a%20personal%20code.)
* **WebFiling Login** (email and password) for filing dormant accounts on the Companies House WebFiling service.[find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/accounts/chooser/dormant#:~:text=You'll%20need%20your%20email%20address%20and%20create,accounts%20on%20the%20Companies%20House%20WebFiling%20service.) *(Note: The joint HMRC and Companies House online accounts/Company Tax Return service closed on 31 March 2026, and software-only iXBRL filing for accounts is scheduled to take effect from **1 April 2028**—so filing dormant accounts via WebFiling remains available now, though you should plan to transition to software ahead of April 2028).*[acenteus-cca.com](https://acenteus-cca.com/blog/companies-house-filing-changes-april-2028#:~:text=No%20for%20annual%20accounts%20filed%20on%20or,2028%2C%20which%20must%20go%20through%20commercial%20software.)

---

### 1. Filing Your Confirmation Statement (Form CS01) DIY
A confirmation statement confirms your company's registered details (officers, registered office, share capital, PSCs) are accurate at least once every 12 months.[www.youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mg0OKo2USBo#:~:text=How%20to%20File%20a%20Confirmation%20Statement%20Online,identity%20verification%20when%20they%20file.%20Chapters%20below.)

1. **Log in to the service:** Go to GOV.UK's *"File a confirmation statement"* service and sign in using your Companies House account / GOV.UK One Login details, company number, and authentication code.[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/file-your-confirmation-statement-with-companies-house#:~:text=How%20to%20register.%20You'll%20need%20a%20Companies,you%20do%20not%20have%20a%20personal%20code.)
2. **Check and update company details:** Review your registered office, SIC codes, directors, shareholders, and People with Significant Control (PSCs). Ensure required director identity verification personal codes are in place.[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/file-your-confirmation-statement-with-companies-house#:~:text=How%20to%20register.%20You'll%20need%20a%20Companies,you%20do%20not%20have%20a%20personal%20code.)
3. **Confirm or update statements:** Confirm that no unnotified changes occurred during the review period, or update any permitted details as prompted.
4. **Pay the statutory fee:** Pay the **£50** online fee by credit or debit card (paper filing costs **£110**).[find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/confirmation-statement#:~:text=Read%20the%20guidance%20on%20filing%20a%20confirmation,to%20process%20than%20if%20you%20file%20online.) Save your submission confirmation—you must file within **14 days** after the end of your review period.[www.youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mg0OKo2USBo#:~:text=How%20to%20File%20a%20Confirmation%20Statement%20Online,identity%20verification%20when%20they%20file.%20Chapters%20below.)

---

### 2. Filing Dormant Company Accounts DIY
Your company generally qualifies as **dormant** for Companies House if it had **no "significant accounting transactions"** during the financial year.[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/dormant-company/dormant-for-companies-house#:~:text=Dormant%20according%20to%20Companies%20House.%20Your%20company,that%20your%20company%20is%20no%20longer%20dormant.) Minor items like your Companies House filing fee, late filing penalties, or share money paid upon incorporation do not count as significant transactions.[www.gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/dormant-company/dormant-for-companies-house#:~:text=Dormant%20according%20to%20Companies%20House.%20Your%20company,that%20your%20company%20is%20no%20longer%20dormant.)

1. **Confirm eligibility:** Verify there were no trading transactions, bank charges/interest treated as significant activity, or asset movements during the period (if you aren't sure whether an item disqualifies dormant status, check GOV.UK guidance before submitting).[libertyaccountinguk.com](https://libertyaccountinguk.com/2025/12/16/dormant-company-accounts-2026-rules/#:~:text=%F0%9F%91%89%20File%20yours%20here%3A%20https%3A%2F%2Flibertyaccountinguk.com%2Fdormant-company-accounts-filing%2F%20Can%20a,full%20compliance.%20Dormant%20Accounts%20vs%20Micro-Entity%20Accounts.)
2. **Sign in to WebFiling:** Access the Companies House WebFiling service using your WebFiling email/password, company number, and authentication code.[find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk](https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/guides/accounts/chooser/dormant#:~:text=You'll%20need%20your%20email%20address%20and%20create,accounts%20on%20the%20Companies%20House%20WebFiling%20service.)
3. **Select dormant company accounts:** Choose the option to file dormant company accounts for your financial year.
4. **Complete the balance sheet & statement:** Enter your called-up share capital (and any cash/balances if applicable) and confirm the statutory dormancy and small-company audit-exemption statements required on the form.
5. **Approve and submit:** A director approves/submits the accounts online—there is **£0 Companies House filing fee** for submitting annual accounts on time (though late filing carries automatic statutory penalties).[libertyaccountinguk.com](https://libertyaccountinguk.com/2025/12/16/dormant-company-accounts-2026-rules/#:~:text=If%20you're%20unsure%2C%20professional%20review%20is%20strongly,filing%20is%20no%20longer%20a%20DIY%20process.)

---

### Quick Cost & Deadline Check

| Filing Type | GOV.UK DIY Fee | Key Timing Rule |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Confirmation Statement | **£50** online (£110 by post) | File at least every 12 months, within **14 days** of review period end |
| Dormant Accounts | **£0** online | File by your Companies House accounts due date (typically **9 months** after accounting reference date for a private company; first accounts have different rules) |

*Separate note on HMRC:* Being dormant for Companies House does not automatically make you dormant for **Corporation Tax**—if HMRC has asked you to file a Company Tax Return or notified you that the company is active for tax, check your HMRC status separately so you don't miss a tax filing notice.

### 1. Filing Your Confirmation Statement (Form CS01) DIY

2. **Sign in to WebFiling:** Access the Companies House WebFiling service using your WebFiling email/password, company number, and authentication code.
3. **Select dormant company accounts:** Choose the option to file dormant company accounts for your financial year.
4. **Complete the balance sheet & statement:** Enter your called-up share capital (and any cash/balances if applicable) and confirm the statutory dormancy and small-company audit-exemption statements required on the form.
